title: Uninstall and Restore Safely
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Uninstall and Restore Safely.
learning_objectives: Explain uninstall and restore safely using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for uninstall and restore safely
Assess failure and operational limits of uninstall and restore safely
concepts_covered: Teardown scripts can remove a cluster and data; backup restore is a separate recovery process.
Uninstall is gated by --yes; runbook covers node replacement, token rotation, and snapshot restoration.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
